inputs.text: This is not really about Father Bernard Domini or one community—it’s a warning about how power expands. France’s “psychological subjection” law gives authorities a vague tool, and the case against the abbot of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame is being used to sell that tool as protection. Once officials get to decide which beliefs count as dangerous, dissent can be recast as a threat and control made to look benevolent. The target today may be this community; the precedent is the point.
